name: opencode-ask
title: OpenCode Ask
description: Ask OpenCode anything without leaving Vicinae. Responses stream straight into the launcher.
author: kaareloun

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask OpenCode
commands.subtitle: Ask AI without leaving Vicinae
commands.description: Type a question, hit Enter, and watch the OpenCode answer stream in.

preferences.name: binary
preferences.title: OpenCode binary
preferences.description: Path or name of the opencode executable.

preferences.name: directory
preferences.title: Working directory
preferences.description: Directory opencode runs in (project context). Empty = home directory.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model override
preferences.description: Provider/model opencode runs as. Default is the free big-pickle for fastest answers.

preferences.name: variant
preferences.title: Reasoning effort variant
preferences.description: Effort opencode runs with (none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Lowest = fastest.

preferences.name: agent
preferences.title: Agent
preferences.description: Agent opencode runs as. Always plan unless you explicitly change it — never build.

preferences.name: auto-ask
preferences.title: Ask fallback text automatically
preferences.label: Auto-ask
preferences.description: When launched from root search with a query (fallback), start asking immediately instead of waiting for Enter.
